initialTask.description: Optional first task to perform after boot. If omitted, the agent runs the built-in 'orient' task: read the active plan tree, summarise where the work stands, then idle waiting for outside messages.

planPath.description: Optional explicit path under docs/plans/ for the orient default to focus on. If omitted, the agent picks the highest-numbered plan folder.

idleBudgetMs.description: Absolute upper bound (ms) on idle time before self-termination. Default 30 minutes (1800000). Acts as the safety net — under the check-in protocol (see prompt.md § 2), this rarely fires because the firstContact/postTask check-ins drive earlier clean exits.

firstContactPollThreshold.description: Enables the first-contact courtesy check-in. Since 027 P5 the companion's stand-down is LEDGER-DRIVEN (it reads idleElapsedMs/unresolvedPeerRequests/idleBudgetSec from coordination_status), so this is now an ENABLE FLAG, not a poll count: > 0 enables the one-shot 'still-needed?' question while awaiting first contact; 0 disables it. The numeric value is retained for back-compat but no longer gates an empty-poll count. Default 20.

postTaskPollThreshold.description: Enables the post-task courtesy check-in. Since 027 P5 (ledger-driven stand-down) this is an ENABLE FLAG, not a poll count: > 0 enables the one-shot 'still-needed?' question after a completed task while idle under budget; 0 disables it. Default 10.

replyWaitPolls.description: DEPRECATED since 027 P5. The ledger-driven idle loop no longer counts empty polls after a check-in to decide the exit — stand-down is driven by idleElapsedMs vs idleBudgetSec (idle_budget), the run-timeout backstop (no_engagement), or control:stop. Retained (minimum 1) only for back-compat; no longer consulted by prompt.md.
